in_marathi.name: Mahalaya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mahalaya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Mahalaya refers to a great goddess, often identified with the Goddess Durga, Lakshmi, or Saraswati. She is the embodiment of strength, grace, and wisdom.
